message: the closure declares `uses clock`, but performs `Cache.fx`

notes.message: `Cache.fx` is the effect argument left out of `Cache[Int, Str]` here; an omitted effect argument stays an abstract effect variable of the function (core 6.2), as Rust and TypeScript generics would infer it, so a `uses` list cannot name it: write the effect argument, `Cache[..., net.dial]` naming the effects of the value passed in, or let the closure's effects be inferred

fixes.title: remove the closure's `uses` clause so its effects are inferred
